flagged.title: Joining & Finishing Polymers
flagged.reason: The video cites boat hulls as an application of hot gas welding of PVC, which would lose marks in an exam because GCSE DT teaches that boat hulls are made from polyester resin (GRP), a thermoset which cannot be welded.

mark_affecting.quote: If you're joining PVC for a massive chemical storage tank or a boat hull, a stream of hot air in hot gas welding does the trick perfectly.
